warnings: PSB uses large-document lengths and requires a PSB-compatible reader. This remains an 8-bit RGB pixel-layer, folder and pixel-mask subset, not editable Photoshop text, vector paths, adjustment parameters or effects. Real multi-GiB and broader reader/device/memory acceptance remain unverified.
Layered output retains independent hidden artwork and supported placed-raster pixels outside the canvas. Choose Flatten for visible-canvas-only delivery.

The bottom 4 top-level layers are merged through “Tone” to preserve unsupported adjustment or conditional blending appearance, including current visibility. Hidden content in that merged portion is not retained.
Vector shape layers are rasterized into pixel layers in PSB export.
Text layers are rendered to pixel layers in PSB export.
Adjustment appearance is baked into pixels; adjustment parameters are not editable in the PSB.

Styles, paint operations and affine transforms are rendered into pixels. Group transforms are baked into descendant pixels; supported integer group origins and ordinary placed-raster bounds are retained. Other rendered content is clipped to document support. Save .luma to retain complete source editability.

Editable vector Bézier paths (rasterized)
Editable text typography (rasterized)
Non-destructive adjustment layers
Group hierarchy inside rendered styles or merged backdrop prefixes
Original affine transforms, styles, paint operations and metadata
